materialMaster.description: Primary identifier used as the canonical material record key.

materialText.description: Readable material description shown to users.

inventoryMeasure.description: Unit used for inventory balances and item counts.

siteCode.description: Owning facility identifier for the material record.

engineeringRevision.description: Approved design revision currently released for production.

technicalDrawing.description: Reference to the controlled design drawing.

batchManaged.description: Whether stock movements require lot or batch traceability.

serializedItem.description: Whether individual units are tracked with unique serial identifiers.

weightUnit.description: Unit applied to net and gross material weight.

standardPrice.description: Standard valuation amount for one inventory unit.

valuationCurrency.description: Currency used by the standard valuation amount.

sourcingMode.description: How the material is supplied: make, buy, or mixed.

plannedDeliveryDays.description: Expected replenishment duration measured in calendar days.

minimumBuffer.description: Inventory reserve protected from normal consumption planning.

merchandiseGroup.description: Commercial family used to group related materials for reporting.

planningController.description: Responsible material planning person or team.

materialType.description: Classification such as raw, semi-finished, or finished material.

procurementGroup.description: Purchasing team responsible for supplier negotiations.

shelfLifeDays.description: Maximum usable life before expiration, in days.

storageCondition.description: Environmental storage requirement such as ambient or refrigerated.

qualityInspectionRequired.description: Whether receipt requires a quality inspection lot.

taxClassification.description: Tax category assigned for commercial transactions.

salesOrganization.description: Selling organization authorized to offer the material.

distributionChannel.description: Commercial route such as wholesale, retail, or direct.

minimumOrderQuantity.description: Smallest quantity accepted on a purchase order.

reorderPoint.description: Inventory level that triggers a new replenishment order.
